_readme: ONE object per casino — same workflow as bookmakers.json:
/casinos/<slug>/     full review page (SEO, Schema.org Review + FAQPage)
/countries/<slug>/   casinos block, filtered by the `countries` field
Join a casino affiliate programme -> real tracking link in `affiliate_url`,
fill the facts, set `placeholder` to false. While true, a visible 'demo entry'
badge is shown so nothing fake reads as a real recommendation.

casinos.name: SpinGalaxy
pros: 4,000+ slots plus a deep Evolution live-casino lobby
E-wallet withdrawals usually land the same day
MGA licence with audited RNG certificates published on-site
cons: 35x wagering on the welcome package is average, not generous
No dedicated desktop app — browser and mobile only
casinos.verdict: The strongest all-round casino in our testing: a huge, well-organised game library, a genuinely fast cashier and top-tier licensing. The welcome package is large but carries standard 35x wagering — read the terms before opting in.

casinos.name: RoyalReels
pros: Local payment rails for India and Nigeria, including UPI
Big 200% headline match for small first deposits
cons: Curaçao licence offers weaker player protection than MGA
40x wagering plus a bonus code make the offer easy to misuse
casinos.verdict: A solid pick for the Indian and Nigerian markets thanks to local payments and a generous headline match — but treat the 40x wagering with respect and stick to the licensed alternatives if player protection is your priority.

casinos.name: AceVegas
pros: Fair 30x wagering — below the market average
PayPal supported for both deposits and withdrawals
Clean table-games section with sensible stake ranges
cons: Slots library is smaller than the market leaders
casinos.verdict: A tidy, safety-first casino with the fairest welcome terms of the sites we rate. The library is smaller than SpinGalaxy's, but everything works, pays out quickly and the PayPal cashier is a real convenience.

casinos.name: NeonSlots
pros: Genuine no-deposit spins — try the lobby without funding
cons: 45x wagering on spin winnings is steep
casinos.verdict: Worth a look for the no-deposit spins alone, and the mobile-first build suits data-conscious players. Just be realistic about converting spin winnings through 45x wagering.

casinos.name: GoldRush
pros: Large match percentage on mid-size deposits
cons: Withdrawals can stretch to three days at weekends
casinos.verdict: A reasonable India-focused option with a big headline match, held back by slower weekend withdrawals. Fine as a second account; not our first pick.
